summary: Explored AR Foundation through a mobile shooter with plane detection, characters, waves, and enemy types.
description: Explored Unity ARCore and AR Foundation by creating a mobile shooter where players choose between two characters with different stats and survive enemy waves placed on real-world detected planes.

highlights.name: AR Foundation
highlights.detail: Integrated ARCore and AR Foundation packages to place the game space on a detected real-world plane.

highlights.name: Combat
highlights.detail: Built simple shooting and melee combat interactions between the player and enemies.

highlights.name: Character Selection
highlights.detail: Created two playable characters with different stats.

highlights.name: Enemy Classes
highlights.detail: Used inheritance to support multiple enemy classes.

highlights.name: Enemy Waves
highlights.detail: Created a three-wave spawner using ScriptableObjects to configure enemies per wave and level.

roles: Designed and developed as a solo project
Designed the character selection system, enemy types, and wave structure
Integrated Unity AR Core and AR Foundation for real-world plane detection
Optimised and built for Android mobile devices
details: Designed and developed a mobile AR shooter game to explore Unity AR Core and AR Foundation. The game places a virtual battlefield on real-world detected planes, creating an immersive experience where enemies appear in the player's physical environment. Players choose from two characters with distinct stats before surviving waves of enemies. Enemy types use inheritance to share base AI behaviour while allowing for varied attack patterns. The wave system is built using scriptable objects, making it straightforward to configure new waves and enemy types without code changes.
